notes.title: ENGLISH LANGUAGE & OTHER UPDATE
notes.content:
Hi there folks,

As we said before we are looking into every single feedback that you've given (on Steam reviews, forums, social media, etc.).

We saw a couple of feedback on the English writing of the game. Now we have improved and updated it with the new patch. We'd want to see your new feedback on it.

We have also updated the five-finger fillet (knife game) difficulty. So, you might want to try it again. :)

We hope that these help for a better experience with the prologue. Every useful review helps us a lot to become better before the full release.

Don't forget to join our Discord channel for any kind of further chat with us on Crowalt:
[b]https://discord.gg/63ExNxvw[/b]

Keep on filling your soul with adventure!

See you soon. :)
